methodology: Exact mirror of BacktestEngine semantics: replay starts at entryIndex+1; if SL and TP1/TP2 occur on the same candle the result is AMBIGUOUS; otherwise SL is checked before TP2, then TP1. Counterfactual mirrors both TP1 and TP2 distances across the entry price. The original replay is the validation gate: if stored baseline outcomes cannot be reproduced, the flip result is not accepted.
